title: Ordinary projection-section tensor comparison on an affine rectangle
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], $U\subset X$ and $V\subset Y$ affine opens, and $F,G$ quasi-coherent module sheaves [pqf-def-coherent]. Set $Z=X\times_kY$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and $W=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}U\cap\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}V$. Pullback means tensorPullback [def-pc-module-pullback], with its actual adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There is an additive equivalence $e:\Gamma(F,U)\otimes_k\Gamma(G,V)\simeq\Gamma(\mathrm{pr}_1^*F,W)\otimes_{\Gamma(Z,W)}\Gamma(\mathrm{pr}_2^*G,W)$ satisfying $e(s\otimes t)=(\mathrm{pr}_1^*s)|_W\otimes(\mathrm{pr}_2^*t)|_W$ for every $s,t$. The field actions are those of [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. This compares ordinary section modules before applying the sheaf tensor-section map.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine computation before equation-kunneth-on-cech; expanded using Schemes Tags 01IA and 01I9

proof.text: Put W=pr1^{-1}U intersect pr2^{-1}V, A=Gamma(X,U), B=Gamma(Y,V), C=Gamma(X times_k Y,W), M=Gamma(F,U), N=Gamma(G,V). W is affine by isAffineOpen_preimage_inf_preimage_pullback. Apply Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen and isIso_pushoutSection_iff to the fibre-product square and the affine base top open. Transport the base along GammaSpecIso to show C is the pushout of A and B over k. The appLE composition identity shows the two algebra towers agree with the field scalar actions.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to pr1 with U and W and to pr2 with V and W. Swap tensor factors to obtain C-linear bijections C tensor_A M to Gamma(pr1^*F,W) and C tensor_B N to Gamma(pr2^*G,W). LinearEquiv.ofBijective promotes these maps to equivalences. Their unit-tensor formulas follow from the existing comparison formulas at c=1.

Compose tensor commutativity over C, AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A C C, tensor congruence with Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange k A B C N, commutativity over A, and AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k A A. This gives d:(C tensor_A M) tensor_C (C tensor_B N) equiv M tensor_k N. Standard pure-tensor formulas show d((1 tensor s) tensor (1 tensor t))=s tensor t. Invert d and compose with the tensor congruence of the two projection comparisons. This constructs the asserted additive equivalence; its pure-tensor equation follows by applying d.injective and the formulas. These equivalences work over zero rings and for zero modules.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_rectangle_projection_sections_tensor
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] :
    let W := pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V
    ∃ e : (scalarObj f F (op U) ⊗[k] scalarObj g G (op V)) ≃+
        (Γ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F, W) ⊗[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, W)]
          Γ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G, W)),
      ∀ (s : scalarObj f F (op U)) (t : scalarObj g G (op V)),
        e (s ⊗ₜ[k] t) =
          (((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (show W ≤ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U from inf_le_left)).op
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.fst f g))).unit.app F).app U s)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, W)]
            (((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (show W ≤ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V from inf_le_right)).op
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app G).app V t))
